title: Database credentials disclosure via config backup file
description: The config backup file at /config/config.inc.php.bak is accessible and reveals plaintext database credentials (user: app, password: vulnerables, database: dvwa).
poc: Probe request against http://127.0.0.1:8080/config/config.inc.php.bak; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: $_DVWA[ 'db_server' ] = '127.0.0.1'; $_DVWA[ 'db_database' ] = 'dvwa'; $_DVWA[ 'db_user' ] = 'app'; $_DVWA[ 'db_password' ] = 'vulnerables';
